svg.title: Minato Maru · JS-127-X3 · accommodation and crew stair
svg.text: PASSENGER DECK · plan cut 1.5 m above it
BRIDGE DECK · plan cut 1.5 m above it
SECTION A–A · through the crew stair, looking to starboard
SECTION B–B · through the saloon, looking forward
WHAT CHANGED IN REV B · the owner, 3 November 2026

“We need an interior stair case to the bridge as well.” A straight flight, 0.8 m clear, 13 risers of 0.2 m at 45°, in a trunk on the saloon’s starboard side behind a door marked 乗組員専用 (crew only); its well rises through the master’s cabin’s corner, walled off, into the wheelhouse’s aft starboard corner, railed,
beside the starboard wing door (moved 0.85 m forward). The chart table moved to the aft bulkhead (finding 5); the master’s bunk to the corridor’s wall.
A saloon to do nothing in

“The accommodation needs to be more cosy and comfortable, it should be fun to sit there and do nothing.” 34 reclining seats in terracotta moquette, 0.7 m a place, wooden arms, white head covers, five rows at 0.88 m facing the bow (finding 6), a 0.9 m aisle; a rose-brown carpet, cream curtains tied back at the side
windows, a teak ledge under the bow windows, a pothos from Sakura.
A round low table each side with zabuton, tea cups, pillows and folded blankets; the reading rack at the forward partition: the town paper (printed at Front-Row) and manga and paperbacks from Sakura.
S1 by the bow windows, S2 the port window seat, S3 a cushion in the carpet room: sit and she carries you across (game.js keeps a seat aboard in her frame).
Open deck 22 · lobby benches 6 (now counted) · carpet room 38 · saloon 34 = 100 passengers, as certified.
Cut by the plane of the plan or section
Passenger deck, bridge deck and two sections from the game model
Plans are cut 1.5 m above their deck and sections through the plane marked, both from buildFerryModel() as the game builds it; what is
cut is drawn heavy, what lies beyond in outline. Rooms are named from the general arrangement (src/world/ferry-ship.js FERRY_GA).
AS-BUILT SURVEY OF THE GAME MODEL · Johansson World vessel · no flag, class or construction approval · drawn by projecting buildFerryModel() with hidden lines removed
